name: Cone of Boiling Acid, Greater
body:
School evocation [acid, fire]; Level shaman 8, sorcerer/wizard 7, witch 8

EFFECT

Range 60 ft.

This spell functions as cone of boiling acid except the cone is larger and the maximum damage is increased to 20d6 and creatures that fail their saving throw take 1d6 fire and 1d6 acid damage each round for 2d4 rounds, or 1 round on a successful one.
